title: Ordinary completed quotient realization of modules
statement: For a scheme X, a commutative ring A, an ideal J and an object U of the coefficient-sized pro-etale site, define the functor from A-modules to completed module sheaves on the slice by constant module realization, canonical coefficient transport, extension to the completed ring and restriction to U. Define F_n by further ordinary extension along the completed projection to A/J^(n+1). Define the natural isomorphism F_(n+1) followed by extension along the successor quotient map to F_n using the existing normalized scalar balancing and the completion cone equation. These are the single-module functors underlying the complexes of [def-sfb-adic-perfect-reduction-model-complexes]; no new choices or data from existence theorems occur.

Single-module quotient Hom evaluation, prior to finite cochain assembly. The rank-one and finite-dual-basis steps of the ordinary module Hom calculation.
